description: Rules for delegating tasks to specific OpenCode agents based on task type, context, and agent availability.

rules.name: Architecture delegation
rules.rationale: Architecture tasks require highest reasoning quality. Only Architect agent has architecture capability.

rules.name: Implementation delegation
rules.rationale: Builder is the sole write agent. All file mutations go through Builder.

rules.name: Review delegation
rules.rationale: Reviewer on Ollama provides adequate quality (0.65) at free cost. Preserves opencode-zen capacity.

rules.name: Audit delegation
rules.rationale: Audit requires deep analysis. OpenCode Zen has highest analysis capability (0.92).

rules.name: Exploration delegation
rules.rationale: Explorer has navigation/search capabilities. Can run in subagent_task mode.

rules.name: Research delegation
rules.rationale: Research has webfetch+websearch. Required for external investigation.

rules.name: Runtime validation delegation
rules.rationale: Runtime agent has bash for execution analysis and diagnostics.

rules.name: Refactoring analysis delegation
rules.rationale: Refactor agent specialized in safe refactoring analysis. Read-only.

rules.name: Routing delegation
rules.rationale: Router selects providers/models/agents for each mission.

rules.name: Fallback: underloaded agent
rules.condition: task_type NOT IN known_types OR NOT agent_available(preferred_agent)
rules.rationale: Explorer is the default fallback for unmatched task types.

rules.name: Load balancing: multi-agent parallel
rules.rationale: Auditor and Reviewer support up to 2 concurrent tasks. Distribute to reduce wait time.
